title: Readman_YYY
author: Terrace
description:
Readman_YYY releases to steam! or rather banned from steam

Readman Your Yielded Yearnings

27 combinations of spawn can... spawn 😎 see the above video, but I made them more modular so that the unit doesn't look like 16 copy pastes.

Replaces the Spawn of Slaanesh Unit specifically when installed.

Enough people didn't want this installed along with the rest of the units, really both sides win as it's not like i scrapped it, you just need to download one extra file (sorry if you were on that team to include it)

<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3553298407> was the old address and now it's here

When searching for a list of all my mods on discord simply type purplebrick there they all are
changelog_latest: When i added the ability for more variants, i accidently made a few combinations "float" as the base model has different sized left arms, the new version adds the large left arm to all variants to cover the problem in a way that's more satisfactory
